selection: First recorded alert per signal family and canonical game, ordered by created_at then id; retain repeats and opposing sides in the audit ledger
primary_population: Fresh, verified, priced, pregame first alerts; show all stale, unknown, unpriced and missing-close observations separately
benchmark: Same-game, same-trigger-capture, same-execution-book moneyline favorite; market probability is a reference, not a signal forecast
uncertainty: 95% game-cluster percentile bootstrap, 2000 replicates, seed 20261012; no independence assumption between same-game alerts
promotion: Manual review only after floor; positive same-book prospective CLV and its lower game-cluster bound, stable fresh-quote returns against the matched market benchmark, coverage review, and further untouched out-of-sample confirmation; never automatic from count alone
rule_changes: New protocol version and future start boundary; never retrofit development results into this forward cohort
